title: Metalium：RISC-V 核上的无符号整数加法
content:
{"zh": "# 任务

提交一个 Metalium 数据搬运 kernel（C++），在 Blackhole 的 Device 0、Tensix 核 `(0, 0)` 上完成两个 `uint32_t` 整数的加法。超出范围时按模 `2^32` 回绕。

你只需提交设备 kernel，不要提交主机 `main()`。系统已经提供可信主机程序：读取输入、分配 DRAM 和 L1、装载你的 kernel，最后把设备结果读回主机。

# 输入与输出

输入是一行 `a b`，范围为 `0 <= a,b <= 4294967295`。评测器检查设备 DRAM 中的实际输出，期望值为 `(a + b) mod 2^32`。

# Kernel 接口

入口是 `void kernel_main()`。六个 runtime arguments 的顺序如下：

| 下标 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 输入 a 的 DRAM 地址 |
| 1 | 输入 b 的 DRAM 地址 |
| 2 | 输出的 DRAM 地址 |
| 3 | 输入 a 的 L1 scratch 地址 |
| 4 | 输入 b 的 L1 scratch 地址 |
| 5 | 输出的 L1 scratch 地址 |

DRAM page size 是 `sizeof(uint32_t)`，buffer interleaved。用 `InterleavedAddrGen<true>` 构造 NoC 地址，用 `noc_async_read` / `noc_async_read_barrier` 读取到 L1，完成计算，然后用 `noc_async_write` / `noc_async_write_barrier` 写回输出 DRAM。发起 NoC 写之前，使用 `ckernel::load_blocking` 确保 RISC-V 的 L1 写已经完成。

评测器使用 `DataMovementProcessor::RISCV_0` 和默认 NoC；输入只能通过给定 DRAM buffer 读取。无需打印任何内容。SDK 是 TT-Metalium 0.79.0，SFPI 7.83.0。

# 示例

输入：
```text
14 7
```
设备输出：`21`。

参考：[Tenstorrent 官方示例](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/tree/main/tt_metal/programming_examples/add_2_integers_in_riscv)。

## 性能剖析

记录中的 Profiling 将热身后的重复主机测量与容器总墙钟时间分别显示。查看中位数、P95、样本数和抖动；若有设备 trace，可逐核心查看各 stage 的 cycles 和微秒。并行 stage 耗时不能直接相加。原始 JSON/CSV 可从记录下载。
", "en": "# Task

Submit a Metalium data movement kernel in C++ that adds two `uint32_t` values on Blackhole **device 0**, Tensix core `(0, 0)`. Overflow wraps modulo `2^32`.

Submit the device kernel only, without a host `main()`. The trusted host reads the input, allocates DRAM and L1 buffers, loads your kernel, and reads the actual output back from device DRAM.

# Input and output

Input is one line `a b`, with `0 <= a,b <= 4294967295`. The output must equal `(a + b) mod 2^32`. Integer results are compared exactly.

# Kernel interface

The entry point is `void kernel_main()`. Its six runtime arguments are:

| Index | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | DRAM address of input a |
| 1 | DRAM address of input b |
| 2 | DRAM address of the output |
| 3 | L1 scratch address for input a |
| 4 | L1 scratch address for input b |
| 5 | L1 scratch address for the output |

DRAM buffers are interleaved with a page size of `sizeof(uint32_t)`. Construct NoC addresses with `InterleavedAddrGen<true>`. Read into L1 using `noc_async_read` and `noc_async_read_barrier`, add the values, then write the result with `noc_async_write` and `noc_async_write_barrier`. Before starting the NoC write, use `ckernel::load_blocking` to ensure the RISC-V write to L1 has completed.

The host uses `DataMovementProcessor::RISCV_0` and its default NoC. Read inputs from the supplied DRAM buffers. Do not print an answer. The SDK is TT-Metalium 0.79.0 with SFPI 7.83.0.

# Example

```text
14 7
```

The value read from output DRAM must be `21`.

Reference: [Tenstorrent's official example](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/tree/main/tt_metal/programming_examples/add_2_integers_in_riscv).


## Profiling

The Profiling panel separates repeated host measurements after warmup from total container wall time. Inspect median, P95, sample count, and jitter. When a device trace is available, inspect cycles and microseconds per core and stage; parallel stage durations must not be summed. Download raw JSON/CSV from the record.
"}
